workResult.summary: Executed only Skill 04 Research Analysis after fail-closed admission, deterministic SHA-256 verification of the authoritative generated Analysis prompt, complete reading of all seven required control/editorial/evidence sources, a durable same-date Wake Receipt, repository-granted global-serial execution authority and a verified Worker Claimed event. The wake arrived before the 13:00 notBefore boundary, so no Analysis business work was performed until repository reconciliation granted authority after 13:00. Consumed only the three completed 2026-08-25 Reading Results and produced exactly three Research Objects. Q-20260825-01 concludes that security-sensitive layered configuration needs explicit authority ownership separate from value precedence: when an effective runtime policy gives credential brokering control of provider/startup inputs, a lower-trust project layer should no longer be able to widen or redirect those owned inputs; the evidence proves only the demonstrated project-layer boundary, not universal credential isolation. Q-20260825-02 concludes that uncertain durable persistence is a first-class recovery state that must gate continuation authority: persist intent, reread authoritative history, classify committed/absent/ambiguous state, and fail closed on ambiguity before new model execution; this is bounded recovery, not distributed exactly-once persistence or external-effect transactionality. Q-20260825-03 concludes that mutable resource discovery is provisional evidence rather than execution authority: after writer ownership is obtained, identity, current location and decision-relevant state should be revalidated before mutation; busy and terminal failure are distinct lifecycle states, and the mechanism does not establish distributed locking or generic exactly-once migration. No prior-day research input, fixed article outline, forced first-party project mapping, article drafting, visualization, Publication Candidate creation or publication was used or performed.

researchObjects.judgment: Security-sensitive layered configuration should model authority ownership separately from value precedence. When effective policy transfers provider/startup inputs to a credential broker, a lower-trust project layer should no longer be able to widen or redirect those owned inputs merely by supplying competing values. The evidence proves this bounded project-layer authority boundary, not universal credential isolation or end-to-end non-exfiltration.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 安全敏感的分层配置应把 Authority Ownership 与 Value Precedence 分开建模。当 Effective Policy 把 Provider/Startup Input 的控制权交给 Credential Broker 后，较低信任的项目层不应仅通过提供竞争值就重新扩大或重定向这些已归属输入。现有证据证明的是有界项目层 Authority Boundary，而不是通用 Credential Isolation 或端到端 Non-exfiltration。

researchObjects.judgment: Resumable execution should treat uncertain persistence as an explicit recovery state that gates continuation authority. Persist the unresolved intent, reread authoritative durable state, classify whether the prior effect is committed, absent or ambiguous, and only then continue; ambiguity should fail closed instead of replaying uncertain work. The demonstrated mechanism is bounded Session recovery, not distributed exactly-once persistence or transactional external effects.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 可恢复 Execution 应把 Uncertain Persistence 视为显式 Recovery State，并用它约束 Continuation Authority。先持久化未决 Intent，再重新读取权威 Durable State，分类上一轮 Effect 是 Committed、Absent 还是 Ambiguous，然后才允许继续；出现歧义应 Fail Closed，而不是重放不确定工作。已证明机制属于有界 Session Recovery，不是分布式 Exactly-once Persistence 或 Transactional External Effect。

researchObjects.judgment: Mutable resource discovery is provisional evidence, not execution authority. If a resource can move or change before writer ownership is obtained, the runtime should revalidate logical identity, current location and decision-relevant state after authority acquisition and before mutation. Busy contention should remain recoverable while terminal failure is recorded separately. The evidence proves a local post-authority revalidation pattern, not distributed locking or generic exactly-once migration.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Mutable Resource Discovery 属于 Provisional Evidence，而不是 Execution Authority。如果 Resource 在取得 Writer Ownership 前可能移动或变化，Runtime 应在获得 Authority 后、Mutation 前重新核验 Logical Identity、Current Location 与决策相关 State。Busy Contention 应保持可恢复，Terminal Failure 则单独记录。现有证据证明的是本地 Post-authority Revalidation Pattern，而不是 Distributed Locking 或通用 Exactly-once Migration。
